data.title: Beyond Static Visual Tokens: Structured Sequential Visual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
data.description: arXiv:2603.26737v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Current multimodal LLMs encode images as static visual prefixes and rely on text-based reasoning, lacking goal-driven and adaptive visual access. Inspired by human visual perception-where attention is selectively and sequentially shifted from the most informative regions to secondary cues-we propose Structural Sequential Visual CoT SSV-CoT. First, a question-relevant saliency map identifies and organizes key visual regions, explicitly modeling the spatial distribution of visual importance. Second, reasoning is performed following this discriminative order, inducing a curriculum-like semantic progression from primary to secondary cues. This method is trained end-to-end, using text cot and answer supervision, without relying on region-level annotations or specialized external tools. Experiments on diverse visual reasoning benchmarks show gains, validating structured and sequential visual cognition.
data.author: Guangfu Guo, Xiaoqian Lu, Yue Feng, Mingming Sun
